claims.claim: September 18 FDA approval of Inluriyo with Verzenio and the September 11 AtaiBeckley acquisition provide realized oncology execution plus neuroscience pipeline optionality; acquisition potential is not realized earnings.

factors.name: oncology regulatory execution
factors.basis: FDA approval broadens the oncology franchise.

factors.name: neuroscience pipeline optionality
factors.basis: Acquisition adds clinical-stage assets whose conversion remains uncertain.

risks.risk: Commercial uptake, clinical conversion, pricing and reimbursement remain uncertain.

unknowns.unknown: Inluriyo launch trajectory and AtaiBeckley clinical conversion remain unknown.

claims.claim: Regulatory conversion is realized execution, while acquired pipeline optionality and future adoption should not be counted as durable revenue before evidence arrives.

factors.name: execution conversion
factors.basis: FDA approval converts a pipeline milestone into a commercializable asset.

risks.risk: Approval does not guarantee durable commercial uptake or margin.

unknowns.unknown: Launch persistence, refill behavior and durable share are not yet established.
